headline: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5, a new 'Opus-class model', promising a cheaper and more efficient alternative to other powerful AI models.
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by new model releases and updates, including SpaceXAI's Grok 4.5 and OpenAI's new voice models. Several startups are also making waves, with Prime Intellect raising $130M to help enterprises build their own AI agents. Meanwhile, concerns about AI safety and regulation continue to grow, with a lawsuit filed against X over the use of Grok to create child sex images.

new_models.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5
new_models.summary: SpaceXAI released the newest version of Grok, promising a cheaper and more efficient alternative to other powerful AI models.
new_models.why_it_matters: This release could significantly impact the AI landscape, making powerful models more accessible to a wider range of users.

new_models.title: OpenAI releases new voice models
new_models.summary: OpenAI released new voice models that can speak and listen at the same time, enabling more natural live conversations.
new_models.why_it_matters: These new voice models could revolutionize the way we interact with AI systems, making them more human-like and intuitive.

research.title: The Real Challenge Limiting AI Models Today
research.summary: The real challenge limiting AI models today is not GPU speed, but rather other factors that are not being addressed.

research.title: DeepSeek DSpark
research.summary: DeepSeek's new DSpark module brings speculative decoding to DeepSeek-V4, boosting per-user generation speed by 60-85% with no drop in model quality.
research.why_it_matters: This innovation could significantly improve the performance of AI models, making them more efficient and effective.

features_updates.title: Google updates Android Bench with new LLMs
features_updates.summary: Google updated Android Bench with new LLMs, adding Fable 5 and other agents to the benchmark.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update could help developers create more effective AI-powered apps for Android devices.

features_updates.title: AlloyDB Ships Proxy Models
features_updates.summary: AlloyDB shipped proxy models that replace LLM calls with local inference inside the database, achieving 2,400x throughput improvement.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This innovation could significantly improve the performance of AI-powered databases, making them more efficient and effective.

industry_business.title: Former OpenAI exec Kevin Weil joins Stoke Space board
